clue.text: Reserve unfinished opus by master for keen reader

indicators.note: something left unfinished stops short, so the word loses its final letter

parts.note: to book is to reserve, as a table or seat
an opus is a musical or literary work
M is the abbreviation for master, as in an MA degree

explanation.surface: Someone books a copy of a master's unfinished opus, as a keen reader would.
explanation.definitionFit: A bookworm is an informal name for a person who loves reading and devours books.

clue.text: Set off in new boat for South American city

indicators.note: one item placed in another goes inside it
a new version of the word is made by putting its letters in another order

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged
to set off is to go

explanation.surface: A traveller sets off in a new boat for a city in South America.
explanation.walkthrough: BOAT becomes BOTA, and GO goes into its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Bogota is the capital of Colombia, a major city in South America.

clue.text: Casanova loses head and lady her heart too

indicators.note: losing its head means the word drops its first letter

parts.note: Casanova was a famous lover

indicators.note: the same verb, loses, applies again, this time to the central letters

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A seducer is beheaded and his lady is left heartbroken.
explanation.walkthrough: LOVER without its first letter, then LADY without its middle two.
explanation.definitionFit: Overly is an adverb meaning excessively, to too great a degree.

clue.text: Cascade flood note to everyone

parts.note: to water is to flood with liquid
F is a musical note
all means everyone

explanation.surface: A torrent pours down and a warning about floods goes out to everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: A cascade is a waterfall, especially a small one falling in steps.

clue.text: Unfortunate consequence of having open cruisers at sea

indicators.note: being at sea means confused and all over the place

parts.note: taken as written, every letter used

explanation.surface: Sailing open-topped boats out at sea brings regrettable results.
explanation.definitionFit: A repercussion is an unintended and usually unwelcome effect of an action.

clue.text: Overtakes on mountain roads

definitions.meaning: first meaning: goes past another vehicle
second meaning: routes through gaps between peaks

explanation.surface: A driver overtakes other cars on winding mountain roads.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for going past another vehicle and the plural noun for routes over mountains.

clue.text: Point of view of fish

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a perspective on a matter
second meaning: to try to catch fish with rod and line

explanation.walkthrough: 'Point of view of fish' reads as a fish's perspective; the second sense is the verb to fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a noun meaning perspective and a verb meaning to go fishing with a hook.

clue.text: Reason to hold a run is promoting of good health

indicators.note: to hold something is to keep it inside

parts.note: reason in the sense of sound mind
taken as written
R is the cricket abbreviation for a run

explanation.surface: Going for a run is a sensible way to stay healthy.
explanation.walkthrough: A and R go inside SANITY.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanitary means relating to hygiene and the conditions that keep people healthy.

clue.text: Bear a red bordered flag

parts.note: to bear something is to stand it, to tolerate it
taken as written

indicators.note: the border of a word is its edges, so only the outside letters are kept

parts.note: the first and last letters of red

explanation.surface: Someone carries a flag with a red border.
explanation.walkthrough: Bear looks like 'carry', but it is the sense of tolerating.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a banner or flag, especially one carried in battle or flown as an emblem.

clue.text: Primate has what sounds like dismal record

indicators.note: the phrase announces that the answer is said the same way as the words that follow

parts.note: grey means dismal, and a tape is a recording

explanation.surface: A monkey seems to have made a gloomy album.
explanation.walkthrough: Say 'grey tape' and it sounds like GREAT APE.
explanation.definitionFit: Great apes, such as gorillas and chimpanzees, are a family of large primates.

clue.text: Time and motion on list for discussion at meeting

parts.note: an age is a period of time

indicators.note: putting letters in motion moves them about into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A time-and-motion study tops the list of items at a business meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Time and motion' reads as one management phrase; here only the middle word is fodder and motion stirs it.
explanation.definitionFit: An agenda is the schedule of items to be considered at a formal meeting.

clue.text: Brothers, for instance, have cool bond

parts.note: brothers are an example of relations, family members
hip means fashionable, cool

explanation.surface: Brothers share a close connection.
explanation.definitionFit: A relationship is the connection or tie between people.

clue.text: Building worker left in the middle of row

indicators.note: placing one thing in the middle of another puts it inside

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A builder is stranded in the middle of a row of houses.
explanation.walkthrough: L goes inside TIER to give TILER.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiler is a tradesman who lays tiles on roofs, floors or walls on building sites.

clue.text: Staggered about leaderless faction being recalled to office

indicators.note: going about something means surrounding it

parts.note: to reel is to stagger

indicators.note: without a leader means the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: a sect is a faction

explanation.surface: A staggering politician from a headless faction somehow gets voted back in.
explanation.walkthrough: The faction is beheaded before it goes inside the staggering.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone re-elected is voted back into the post they held, returned to office for another term.

clue.text: Producer chap at Universal has problem keeping up routine

indicators.note: something keeping another item holds it inside

parts.note: a chap is a man
U is the film certificate for universal viewing
a facer is a sudden difficulty or problem

indicators.note: in a down clue's sense, going up reads a word from bottom to top, i.e. backwards

parts.note: a rut is a dull routine

explanation.surface: A man working at Universal Studios struggles to keep up with the routine.
explanation.walkthrough: Universal suggests the film studio, but it is the U film certificate. A facer is a dated word for a sudden difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: A manufacturer is a company or person that makes goods, a producer of products.

clue.text: Favour gallery keeping fake version of 'Last Supper'

indicators.note: something keeping another item holds it inside

parts.note: the Tate is a group of London art galleries

indicators.note: a version of a word is a different form of it, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

indicators.note: last points to the final letter of the word that follows

parts.note: the final letter of Supper

explanation.surface: A gallery shows a forged copy of Leonardo's Last Supper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Last Supper' reads as the painting, but Last just picks the end of Supper. The Tate is London's best-known group of art galleries.
explanation.definitionFit: To favour a parent is to resemble them, which is what take after means.

clue.text: Abandoned fire-arm

parts.note: a called-off event is abandoned
to fire a gun is to shoot

explanation.surface: Someone has ditched a gun.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphen joins 'fire-arm' into firearm; split it and arm is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An offshoot is a branch or subsidiary, an arm of a larger organisation or a plant.

clue.text: Chap brought in to advise about cement, say

indicators.note: being brought in to something places it inside
moving letters about shifts them into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
a chap is referred to as he

explanation.surface: A man is called in to give advice on concrete.
explanation.definitionFit: Cement is one example of an adhesive, a substance used to stick things together.

clue.text: Used to play the violin? Nonsense!

definitions.meaning: first meaning, read literally: the bows a fiddler uses
second meaning: an old-fashioned exclamation of dismissal

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the literal reading: a fiddle is a violin, so its bows are fiddle sticks.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a dated exclamation meaning rubbish, and also literally the bows played on a fiddle.

clue.text: Won't half find bearing flu awfully miserable

indicators.note: keeping only half of the word means the rest is cut away

parts.note: taken as written, ignoring the apostrophe
a compass bearing, E for east

indicators.note: something done awfully is badly done, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone stubbornly refuses to admit how wretched the flu makes them feel.
explanation.definitionFit: Woeful means full of sorrow, wretched and unhappy.

clue.text: Advocate the French system; without a Queen

parts.note: la is French for the, feminine

indicators.note: without means lacking, so the next item is taken out

parts.note: a way is a system or method
the letter removed
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: A French legal system is described as having no queen.
explanation.walkthrough: The semicolon hides that 'without a' applies only to system; the Queen is then added at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: An advocate is a lawyer who pleads cases in court.

clue.text: Maize first sprouts little time before main crop

indicators.note: first points to the opening letter of the word that follows

parts.note: the opening letter of sprouts
wee is Scottish for little
T is the abbreviation for time
corn is the principal cereal crop

explanation.surface: A maize field: the first shoots appear shortly before the main harvest.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweetcorn is a variety of maize grown for its sugary kernels, eaten as a vegetable.

clue.text: Tense about point of cruel remark

indicators.note: going about something means surrounding it

parts.note: taut means tense, stretched tight
N is a compass point, north

explanation.surface: Everyone tenses up at the sting of a nasty comment.
explanation.definitionFit: A taunt is a jeering or insulting jibe meant to provoke someone.

clue.text: Selection of flowers from Kilimanjaro makes lovely perfume

indicators.note: a selection taken from the words that follow is a run of letters lifted straight out of them

parts.note: the letters run across the end of the mountain's name and the start of the next word

explanation.surface: A bouquet of flowers picked on Kilimanjaro gives off a lovely scent.
explanation.definitionFit: An aroma is a distinctive, usually pleasant smell, the sort a fine scent gives off.

clue.text: Bills coming after party's over is extremely unpleasant!

indicators.note: turned over means flipped, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a do is a party
IOUs are written promises to pay, bills of debt

explanation.surface: The bills arriving once the party's over are a horrible shock.
explanation.definitionFit: Odious means hateful or repulsive, thoroughly unpleasant.

clue.text: Pest problem why I left?

indicators.note: a problem with the words suggests they are in a mess and must be sorted out afresh

parts.note: taken as written, every letter used

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a pest problem is the reason they moved out.
explanation.definitionFit: Whitefly are tiny sap-sucking insects that damage plants, a common garden pest.

clue.text: Agreement to give medical help to young

parts.note: to treat a patient is to give medical help
Y is the abbreviation for young

explanation.surface: A deal is struck to provide medical care for children.
explanation.definitionFit: A treaty is a formal agreement, especially between nations.

clue.text: Firework box contains rules kept loosely initially by English

indicators.note: a box that contains things holds them inside it

parts.note: to spar is to box, as in practice

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of each of the preceding words

parts.note: the opening letters of those three words
E is the abbreviation for English

explanation.surface: A box of fireworks comes with English safety rules only loosely followed.
explanation.walkthrough: Box looks like a container noun, but it is the verb meaning to fight with fists in practice.
explanation.definitionFit: A sparkler is a hand-held firework that throws off bright sparks as it burns.
